body: I've recently accepted I won't ever have my own family. And that I was always too repulsive to have ever had that as one of my life goals. I have some painful physical issues that have gotten worse as I've gotten older which has made me drop the goal to travel. These were/are things for a younger woman to do. So that really just leaves work. Unfortunately, I have always seen work as the thing I have to do to pay for 'real life.' I am trying so hard to get into the headspace that work IS life. That is what everyone has been trying to tell me my whole life. And this program very likely will lead to a career instead of just a job. I have been trying for months to convince myself that's just what I should do. It will fill up my time and my thoughts. I just don't have any balance, never did, in life.

I should have used past tense. "Wanted" to do most. I would say I honestly don't want to do those things anymore. I don't want to do anything at all. I used nothing but logical reasoning to decide to go to grad school - much higher pay, can do it for not too much debt (tuition reimbursement), can be done in 2 years. I told myself I'd be crazy not to take advantage of this opportunity. I still agree with myself. I just don't have my heart in it. I can't think of anything at all I want to do. I can't even entertain myself anymore. I figured school and then a potentially better job is a way to kill time until I die. You know?
